newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Rabin's widow says Israeli left always the victim.
newsitem.headline: Rabin's widow says Israeli left always the victim.

text.p: The widow of assassinated Israeli Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin said on Thursday Israel's left wing was always the victim of political violence and the right was always the aggressor.

"No one ever fired from left to right. If shots were fired, they were fired from right to left and this is no coincidence," Leah Rabin said at a memorial ceremony marking the one-year anniversary of her husband's murder.
"There is a certain style, which is on the one hand violent and on the other hand takes...violence up to a point, up to murder," she said.
Right-wing religious Jew Yigal Amir shot Rabin dead at a Tel Aviv peace rally nearly a year ago. Israelis marked the assassination on Thursday according to the Jewish calendar.

Leah Rabin was responding to remarks made on Wednesday by Education Minister Zevulun Hammer of the right-wing National Religious Party, who said it was wrong to blame all Israelis who opposed Rabin's peace policies.
"You cannot implicate an entire segment of the population," he told Israel Television. "Bullets don't only fly from right to left...they fly both ways."
